import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=len(df['brand'].unique()))
brand_colors = dict(zip(df['brand'].unique(), colors))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=[brand_colors[brand]], s=brand_data['weight_grams']/5, 
                alpha=0.7, label=brand, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels (size = weight)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left')

# 2. Bar chart - Price by Brand
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)
brand_prices = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax2.barh(brand_prices.index, brand_prices.values, 
                color=[brand_colors[b] for b in brand_prices.index], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (brand, price) in enumerate(brand_prices.items()):
    ax2.text(price + 50, i, f'${price:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 3. Sensor Type Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 3)
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(sensor_counts)),
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(sensor_counts), shadow=True)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Model Year vs Max ISO with body type
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 4)
body_markers = {'Compact': 'o', 'Mirrorless': 's', 'DSLR': '^'}
for body_type in df['body_type'].unique():
    body_data = df[df['body_type'] == body_type]
    ax4.scatter(body_data['model_year'], body_data['max_iso'], 
                marker=body_markers.get(body_type, 'o'), s=100,
                c=[brand_colors[b] for b in body_data['brand']], 
                label=body_type, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Max ISO by Model Year (shape = body type)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Body Type', loc='upper left')
ax4.set_yscale('log')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
